observations.behavior: Adds PubSub dependency to TeamWorkflowsConfigService constructor, enabling event-driven refresh.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the service to refresh cached team email suspension status immediately when a PubSub event announces a provider state change, rather than waiting for the refresh age to expire.

observations.behavior: Changes suspension check return type and adds provider status handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the service to distinguish between staff-imposed suspension and AWS provider-imposed suspension, and to return null on lookup failure instead of false, supporting the 'fails open' requirement.

observations.behavior: Adds database column selection for provider suspension status.
observations.posthog_connection: Retrieves the AWS SES tenant sending status from the database, which is required to detect provider-imposed suspension.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function _announce_state_change(team_id) that calls reload_team_workflows_config_on_workers(team_id) and logs exceptions. P1.F9.H3 adds transaction.on_commit(lambda: _announce_state_change(team_id)) after updating SES tenant state, scheduling the reload after the transaction commits.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog’s SES tenant state workflow by ensuring worker workers re-read the cached row after the authoritative state is updated, potentially reducing stale-cache behavior. The implementation relies on an existing helper and a transactional callback; no tests or broader dependency changes are shown. No score assigned.
